import datetime as dt,hashlib,json,re,urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
url="https://zenodo.org/records/19636649"
with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=30) as response:
    html=response.read().decode()
blocks=re.findall(r'<script[^>]*type=["\x27]application/ld\+json["\x27][^>]*>(.*?)</script>',html,re.S|re.I)
records=[json.loads(block) for block in blocks]
assert records
out={"checked_utc":dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"url":url,"html_sha256":hashlib.sha256(html.encode()).hexdigest(),"json_ld":records}
Path("data/raw/zenodo_public_metadata.json").write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(out))
